_about: What each of the 13 skills' icon (Skills window) shows, for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set proficiencies. One tool or object that is the craft itself, a different shape and colour for each, readable at 26 px.
alchemy: A round glass flask of glowing green potion with a cork, a sprig of herbs tied around its neck
archery: A curved wooden longbow with a nocked arrow with grey goose feathers, drawn at an angle
armorcrafting: A small iron helmet with a nose guard resting on a folded piece of chain mail
construction: A wooden mallet crossed with a carpenter's square, over a squared timber beam
cooking: A small black iron cooking pot with a wooden ladle, steam rising, a sprig of thyme on the rim
fishing: A wooden fishing rod with a line ending in a silver hook, a small silver trout hanging from it
foraging: A small woven wicker basket full of red lingonberries, a golden chanterelle mushroom and green leaves
melee: A Norse steel sword crossed over a round wooden shield painted red with an iron boss
mining: An iron pickaxe with a wooden haft resting on a chunk of grey rock with a seam of orange copper ore
runecraft: A flat grey rune stone with a glowing pale blue Norse rune carved into it
sneaking: A dark grey hooded cloak, the hood empty and shadowed, a small dagger at its side
weaponcrafting: A blacksmith's hammer resting on a black iron anvil beside a glowing orange sword blade
woodcutting: A felling axe with a long wooden haft stuck into the top of a round birch log with white bark
horsemanship: A worn brown leather saddle with a coiled rope lasso hung on its horn, a single iron horseshoe beside it
